questions.stem: A patient with rheumatoid arthritis who is noncompliant with treatment presents with complaints of superior field loss of vision for the past week. What is the most likely cause of this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Branched retinal artery occlusion B) Central retinal artery occlusion C) Branched retinal vein occlusion D) Central retinal vein occlusion
